ActCraft
Features Status Build Source code

Backing tracks and lights, one show.

ActCraft plays your multitrack backing tracks and runs your stage lighting from a single show file, on one shared clock. Open source, native on Windows, macOS and Linux.

Build it See what works today

What it does

Multitrack playback

Up to 64 tracks per song with volume, pan, 4-band EQ, mute and 16 output buses. Tracks stay sample-locked for the whole song.

Metronome

Click on its own bus, count-in per song, start on the beat, visual-only mode for silent stages.

Setlists

Playlists split into sets, smart playlists by rules, a play queue, history and quick search with AND, OR and NOT.

Mute groups

Six labelled groups to drop whole parts of the arrangement live, from the window or by remote.

Remote control

Every action is a command: run it from the window, the command line, a local JSON channel or an AI assistant over MCP.

Lighting (coming)

DMX over Art-Net, sACN and USB, fixtures, effects and cues that follow the song's tempo.

Build and run

You need a Rust toolchain. Then:

cargo run -p actcraft --bin actcraft          # the window
cargo run -p actcraft --bin actcraft-cli -- commands
cargo xtask ci                                # checks before every commit
